Extend tail-hooks and tail-ledger selftests with a two-tail case (33/33 must stay green). Do not edit any script a running list or batch uses mid-run. Checkpoint and commit with identity shaylanger, one fix per commit, push. Keep C:\KenshiTestRuns\agents\imm26-tailroute.status current via agent-status.ps1. Report to agents\out\imm26-tailroute in 8 lines or fewer.
